schema.rows[].real_model: model string of the real driver this row stands in for, or "*" for the catch-all row
schema.rows[].api: the Viam API both the real model and the sim model serve, or "*" on the catch-all row, which matches any hardware API with no row
schema.rows[].sim_model: the sim model constructed in the real one's place. On the catch-all row it is rdk:builtin:fake, a placeholder generic component
schema.rows[].template: attributes of the swapped resource. The resolver adds world_attribute set to the simulator field's value. A string value starting with "$" copies that field of the real resource's config ("$frame.parent" is the frame parent's name)
schema.rows[].carry: map from an attribute name on the real resource to the sim attribute it becomes. The resolver copies the value unchanged when the real entry has it and skips it otherwise. {} when nothing carries
schema.rows[].verified: true when real_model was read from the real module's manifest, README or the Viam docs on the date in rows[].source. False when it follows the module's naming pattern but was not found in its published model list
schema.rows[].source: where real_model was read, and when
schema.rows[].note: optional, anything the resolver or a reader should know about the row

rows.note: flagged unverified because viam-franka-arm publishes no kinematics file for the franka asset to carry, unlike the UR module, so a resolved Franka arm cannot answer GetKinematics, GetEndPosition or MoveToPosition

the sim gripper needs the arm it is bolted to. The real entry carries that only as its frame parent, so the template copies it from there. The real model also covers the 2F-140, which differs from the 2F-85 in stroke and TCP offset, and nothing in the real entry's config distinguishes the two, so every resolved gripper becomes a 2F-85 with the 2F-85's measured TCP offset

the sim vacuum needs the arm it is bolted to, carried from the frame parent the same way the 2f-grippers row does. host, port, mode, max_pressure_pct, min_pressure_pct, timeout_ms and include_realsense configure a URCap socket connection and real pressure registers the sim has no equivalent for, so nothing carries. the sim holds through Isaac's surface gripper, contact-gated, with the EPick's own measured geometry and kinematics document. grab_delay_ms is not a real epick attribute at all, it belongs to this module's own simulated-epick-vacuum-gripper model, so it is not listed here even though the sim's own grab_delay_ms attribute matches its name and default
a jetbot is a wheeled base over two motors. The motors have no sim row and are left as they are, so a machine-level swap of a jetbot still needs them removed or faked

the frame is carried over unchanged and places the sim camera. width_px and height_px carry to the sim camera's width and height. A depth stream requested through the sensors list becomes depth: true by a resolver rule, since that is a transform, not a copy

any hardware component with no row becomes a placeholder on its own api with model rdk:builtin:fake, keeping its name, frame and depends_on and dropping its attributes, so the sim machine's config loads and dependents that resolve by api keep working. pose_tracker is the one api that changes, to rdk:component:generic, since no fake pose_tracker model exists. allow_unmatched keeps the real entry instead
